runtime_contract: original BF16 expanded exactly per tile; ordered FP64 arithmetic unchanged

fp32_comparison.rationale: Preserve the increment7 practical FP32 criterion for the same Llama graph; 24 blocks instead of 30 but wider reductions. This is an experimental acceptance threshold, not a theoretical global error bound. A failure is retained and diagnosed, never relaxed after measurement.
fp32_comparison.argmax: exact equality at every compared position
scenarios: five-token prefill plus three incremental greedy decodes

mode_format_comparison: bitwise equality of all captured FP64 arrays and input/greedy IDs

memory.oracle_loader: meta model, promote one original BF16 tensor at a time to FP32; unmap source before proceeding; tie head once
memory.rejected_naive_loading: resident BF16 model followed by .float() can combine checkpoint mappings, BF16 and FP32 residents
memory.oracle_fp64_1p7b: not attempted: parameters alone exceed total WSL RAM; increment7 full FP64 gate stays mandatory

disk.copies: one original and one optional standard whole-tensor repack; no HF cache, no FP32 disk checkpoint

cache: buffered and uncontrolled; SHA before forward, per-process read_bytes recorded; no global cache eviction and no NVMe speed claims
performance: three sequential alternating sync/pipeline pairs; initial 1 GiB smoke retained separately; no autotuning
